0022600093.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Sacramento Kings visit the LA Clippers. Sacramento is without Dylan Cardwell (calf strain) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), while the Clippers are missing Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (foot) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery). The Kings lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 138-109 defeat in Sacramento on April 5, 2026, their most recent meeting, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Sacramento a 35% chance to win.
